title: feat(search): add fuzzy search with fzf-like scoring algorithm

commits.message: feat(search): add fuzzy search with fzf-like scoring algorithm
docs(core/fuzzy): add JSDoc to scoring constants explaining value rationale

fix(search): wire fuzzy checkbox into CM6 search flow and fix review issues

- Issue 1: Add fuzzy-aware navigation wrappers (fuzzyAwareFindNext/Previous/
  SelectMatches/ReplaceNext/ReplaceAll) that detect the panel's fuzzy
  checkbox state and delegate to findSearchMatches when active, replacing
  all button handlers and Enter key handler that previously called CM6's
  built-in (fuzzy-oblivious) findNext/findPrevious directly.
- Issue 2: Merge per-character fuzzy matches into single span per line hit
  (from/to covering first-to-last matched char), matching the regex path's
  'one match = one span' contract for correct navigation/replace/count.
- Issue 3: replaceAllMatches now handles fuzzy mode via left-to-right match
  substitution with offset adjustment after each replacement.
- CRLF: Normalize \\r\\n to \\n before splitting so stray \\r does not leak
  into SearchMatch.text on Windows documents.
- Optimization: Use fuzzyMatch() instead of fuzzyFilter(query, [line])
  for single-candidate lines.
- JSDoc: Soften word-boundary invariant claim to note it holds for typical
  short editor queries but can be overcome by linear gap accumulation.
